end_card.headline: Answer every enquiry. Book more patients.

clips.line: A few unanswered WhatsApp enquiries don't seem like a big deal. Now multiply that across all your clinic locations.

line.say: A few unanswered WhatsApp enquiries don't seem like a big deal.
Now multiply that across all your clinic locations.

prompt.delivery: Easy and conversational, slightly wry on "don't seem like a big deal", then leaning in with weight on "multiply".
prompt.gesture: on "WhatsApp" he turns one open palm toward frame right; on "multiply" he spreads both hands apart above the table.

scenes.name: UnansweredInbox
scenes.idea: One clinic's front-desk phone, late evening: a generic green chat list where three patient enquiries sit with grey single ticks and a red unread badge — small, polite, easy to ignore. On "deal" the phone settles back a little (no alarm, nothing happens). On "multiply" identical phones slide out from behind it as a fanned deck, each tagged with a different clinic location, so one inbox becomes many.

chats.text_en: How much is laser hair removal?

chats.name: Khalid
chats.text_en: Is Dr. Sara in on Saturday?

props.notes: Names, numbers and locations are illustrative placeholders. Generic green chat styling only — no WhatsApp logo. Arabic bubbles carry a small grey English line beneath.

clips.line: One at your first clinic. Another at your second. And more across the rest of your network.

line.say: And more across the rest of your network.

prompt.delivery: Counting off, unhurried, a small beat between each clinic, building on "the rest of your network".
prompt.gesture: on "first" he places one hand on the table, on "second" a little further along it, and on "network" he sweeps that hand wide across the table.

scenes.name: ClinicNetworkMap
scenes.idea: A dark, stylised map of the UAE coast (Abu Dhabi → Dubai → Sharjah, Al Ain inland) in brand navy. Each clinic is a pin; as he counts, a pin drops and a small grey chat bubble with an amber 'no reply' pulse hangs over it. On "rest" the remaining pins pop in a fast ripple, each with its own pulsing bubble, and on "network" thin teal lines join them into one chain — the whole network is quietly leaking.

props.notes: Locations are illustrative (replace with the client's real branches). Keep every pin and label out of the 16:9 bottom-left pip corner and the bottom 150u caption band, and out of the 9:16 top-right pip corner and the y 640–720 caption band — frame the map so the Abu Dhabi end sits clear of the corner.

clips.line: Each one could be a potential patient you paid to attract, but never converted into a booking.

line.say: Each one could be a potential patient you paid to attract,
but never converted into a booking.

prompt.delivery: Quieter and pointed, a slight shake of the head on "never converted".
prompt.gesture: on "patient" he opens one palm toward frame right and holds it there briefly.

scenes.name: LostLeadTrail
scenes.idea: Zoom into one of those bubbles and it becomes a person: a patient card (photo-less avatar, name, what she wanted). Above it, on "paid", the ad that brought her in stamps a cost tag — this enquiry was bought. A dotted path then runs down from her card toward a calendar slot; on "never" the path stalls and fades, and on "booking" the slot stays an empty dashed outline marked 'Not booked'. Money in, nothing out.

props.notes: Cost per lead is illustrative — label it 'Illustrative' on screen unless the client supplies a real figure. Ad source is a generic 'Social media ad' card, no platform logos.

clips.line: Now imagine how many booking opportunities your entire chain could be missing over a month.

line.say: Now imagine how many booking opportunities
your entire chain could be missing over a month.

prompt.delivery: Slower, inviting the listener to picture it, with weight on "entire chain" and "month".
prompt.gesture: on "imagine" he lifts both hands, palms up, and holds them apart.

scenes.name: MissedMonthHeatmap
scenes.idea: The single empty slot from the last beat multiplies into a month: a grid with one row per clinic and one column per day. On "chain" all clinic rows are in place; from "missing" the cells fill left to right, day by day, in deepening amber as missed booking opportunities pile up, while a counter in the corner races upward. On "month" the last column fills and the total lands — the size of the problem, at chain scale.

props.notes: 960 = 8 clinics × ~4 a day × 30 days, invented — show 'Illustrative' under the counter. 9:16: transpose to clinics as columns, days as rows. Keep the counter out of the pip corners and caption bands.

clips.line: Hey Anaya responds to all your leads instantly and in their preferred language, crafts messages that convert, and then schedules the appointments.

line.say: Hey Anaya responds to all your leads instantly

prompt.delivery: Brighter and confident, the turn of the story; crisp and even on "instantly", keeping a steady pace through the list without rushing.
prompt.gesture: on "responds" he opens one hand toward frame right, then marks each item of the list with a small, light hand movement.

scenes.name: AnayaBooksIt
scenes.idea: The same kind of phone as the hook, but now HeyAnaya is on it, and it does each thing as he names it. On "responds" Mariam's Arabic enquiry arrives; on "instantly" Anaya's reply appears with a 'Replied in 3 s' chip. On "language" a small EN→AR chip flips and the reply is in Gulf Arabic (grey English line beneath). On "crafts" the reply offers two concrete slots with the doctor's name; on "convert" she taps 'Thu 4:30 PM'. On "schedules" a teal confirmation card slides out of the chat and on "appointments" it drops into the clinic calendar — the dashed empty slot from beat 03, now filled.

props.reply_ar: أهلاً مريم! عندنا موعد مع د. ليلى يوم الخميس ٤:٣٠ أو السبت ١١ الصبح. أي واحد يناسبك؟
props.reply_en: Hi Mariam! Dr. Layla has Thu 4:30 PM or Sat 11 AM. Which suits you?
props.notes: Response time and names are illustrative. Generic green chat styling, HeyAnaya shown as the sender name with the brand mark (logo-white.png on dark), no WhatsApp branding. Arabic copy needs a native-speaker check.

clips.line: Because growing a clinic chain isn't just about generating more leads.

line.say: isn't just about generating more leads.

prompt.delivery: Calm and certain, sharing a conviction, a thoughtful beat before "generating more leads".
prompt.gesture: on "generating" he makes a small pouring motion with one hand above the table, then lowers it.

scenes.name: LeakyFunnel
scenes.idea: A clean funnel on navy: lead dots pour in from the top (ad spend tap). On "more" the tap opens wider and the inflow doubles — but the funnel's sides have gaps marked 'No reply', 'After hours', 'Wrong language', and most of the extra dots spill out through them; the bookings tray at the bottom barely rises. More leads, same leak.

props.notes: No numbers — dot flow only. Keep the funnel centred-right in 16:9 so the bottom-left pip corner and caption band stay clear; in 9:16 keep the leak labels below the top-right pip.

clips.line: It's about turning more of the leads you already have into bookings.

line.say: It's about turning more of the leads

prompt.delivery: Warm and resolved, landing firmly on "bookings" with a small, assured smile.
prompt.gesture: on "bookings" he sets one hand down flat on the table toward frame right.

scenes.name: SealedFunnel
scenes.idea: The same funnel, answered. On "turning" teal HeyAnaya patches seal each leak gap; on "leads" the dots already inside stop spilling and flow straight down; on "already" the tap at the top closes to its original trickle — no new spend. On "bookings" the dots land as teal appointment blocks filling a week calendar at the bottom. Same leads, more bookings.

props.notes: Mirror of LeakyFunnel so the change reads instantly; no numbers. The patches may carry the logo-white.png mark.
